items.title: Special termination right to avoid the price increase
items.quote: Sie können den Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung kündigen.
items.computation: The new prices take effect on 01.11.2026 ('zum 01.11.2026 ändern sich die Preise'). The letter grants a special right to terminate without any notice period, effective at the moment the price change takes effect. To still avoid paying the higher price, the termination in text form must reach the supplier before the new prices become effective, i.e. by the last day before 01.11.2026, which is 31.10.2026 (a Saturday, no shift applies since this is a contractual/self-set deadline for a declaration to a company, not a statutory period governed by §193 BGB weekend-shift rules; to be safe it should arrive by the last business day before, Friday 30.10.2026). Using the plain reading of the letter, the last calendar day is 31.10.2026.

warnings: The letter does not state an explicit calendar deadline for the special termination right, only that cancellation is possible 'ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung' (01.11.2026); the due date of 2026-10-31 is inferred and should be checked, and sending the cancellation a few days earlier (e.g. by 2026-10-30, a business day) is advisable to be safe.

The Grundpreis is listed as unchanged (14,50 → 14,50 €/Monat) while the Arbeitspreis and monthly Abschlag increase; only the Arbeitspreis increase is a genuine price change triggering the special termination right, so verify this is correctly a qualifying price increase under the contract terms.
